description:
🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27

Two Districts, One Rotary Family – A Night of Friendship, Culture & Fellowship!

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
Rotary Club de América | District 4895, Argentina

The Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27 delegation from Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, enjoyed a memorable evening of fellowship with the Rotary Club of América, District 4895, Argentina. The meeting celebrated the true spirit of Rotary—building bridges across borders, embracing cultural diversity and creating friendships that last a lifetime.

🍕 A Warm Welcome Over Dinner

The evening began with a delicious dinner featuring lovely pizzas, creating a relaxed and cheerful atmosphere for Rotarians from both districts to connect and share experiences.

🎤 An Evening of Meaningful Exchanges

The formal meeting opened with a warm welcome by Rtn. Paula of District 4895. Dr. Kamalini Pathak, Team Leader of the Indian delegation, addressed the gathering, expressing gratitude to all attendees for their hospitality and for making the exchange so special.

🌏 Celebrating the Richness of Indian Culture

A highlight of the evening was the presentation on Indian culture by PDG Gopal Mandhania. The presentation offered the Argentine Rotarians an engaging glimpse into India's traditions, heritage and cultural diversity, strengthening mutual understanding and appreciation.

🚩 Flags Exchanged, Friendships Strengthened

The flag exchange between District 3141, India, and District 4895, Argentina, was a proud and symbolic moment of the meeting. It represented the growing bond between the two districts and their shared commitment to Rotary's ideals of service, goodwill and international understanding.

Rtn. Lalit Sukhani delivered the vote of thanks, appreciating the warm welcome, excellent hospitality and wonderful fellowship extended by the host club.

❤️The Meeting Ended, but the Memories Will Last Forever!

The evening concluded on a happy note, filled with smiles, meaningful conversations and renewed friendships. The gathering beautifully demonstrated how Rotary Friendship Exchange transforms international visits into lasting relationships and brings Rotarians closer as one global family.

Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27
District 3141, India 🤝 District 4895, Argentina

One World. One Rotary Family. Friendships Without Borders.

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
